text: The future of AI is a topic that many people discuss today. Most AI systems we use now are designed for specific tasks, like translating languages or recommending videos. However, researchers are working on general AI, also called AGI, which could understand and learn any task like a human. This technology could bring great benefits, such as better medical care and solutions to climate problems. At the same time, there are serious risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Experts disagree about when AGI might arrive; some predict it within ten years, while others believe it is still far away.
